name: recallweave-fallback
description: RecallWeave shadow-memory and Supermemory export fallback kit.

interface.shortDescription: Shadow memory, export, and benchmark fallback tools.
interface.longDescription: RecallWeave Fallback packages the current shadow-memory workflow, redaction rules, Supermemory export script, Hermes canary provider, and benchmark instructions. It is designed as an alternative or fallback lane while hosted Supermemory write credits are constrained.
defaultPrompt: Check whether memory writes are healthy.
